description: Curated taxi and cab services for New England in Motion: licensed taxicab companies, dispatch associations, and official taxi stands, each confirmed from an official list, an airport or station page, or the operator's own site. A directory, not live cab positions. Built into public/data/reference-places.geojson by build-reference-places.py.
reviewNotes: Four candidates were left out on review: three confirmed only by a 2019-dated regional list and one whose own site was suspended. Every url and sourceUrl answered on 2026-10-04.
